why_tall: the tallest crowns (65-71 m) all stand on the rim of the Capilano River canyon at the world's east edge, outside the boundary: the canyon's old-growth Douglas firs are among the tallest near Vancouver, and the surface-minus-ground height may also be inflated on the canyon wall
